mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a cool 51 degrees with clear skies over Badger Ridge Middle School and a Waxing Gibbous moon in the sky.

City officials have announced that road maintenance for crack filling begins September 28. Roadways will stay open, but please drive cautiously through work zones. Also, the Plan Commission is set to review several development projects on October 5, including site plans in the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in town. We have trivia at Hop Haus Brewing today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or Yoga at Insight Wellness.
On September 5, the Verona Police Department responded to reports of multiple vehicles with slices of cheese on their windshields, identified as a viral social media prank called the Dairy Dare.
The Culver's of Verona is finishing a remodel and will open today at 10:00 AM. Stop in to see what they have in store for you once they reopen.
